title: start warns of an item that waits on a trigger or a host the sprint cannot reach
goal: backlog.py start warns, naming each, of a sprint item (or a task under it) that waits on an unfired trigger or names a host other than the one starting the sprint in its trigger, so the operator moves it out or accepts that the review waits on it; a test plants an item with an unfired trigger. Answers the SP-w3xmbdra retrospective: four items waiting on a Claude Code release or the Windows host held the sprint's review until they were moved out.
